services.desc: This class is for kids ages 8-13. years old. Our objective for the kids’ program is to prioritize self-defense, ensuring our students are equipped to protect themselves when necessary. services.name: Adult Sparring
services.desc: Students will learn fighting techniques and how to apply what they learn through drills and sparring. All sparring takes place in a controlled environment where each student will spar at their appropriate levels and the levels that he or she agrees upon. Students will always practice sparring while wearing light protective fighting gear from head to toe. This class also prepares students for karate tournaments.
